tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Technical Dance Skills

questions.question: Q: What is the difference between posture and alignment?
questions.correctAnswer: Posture is the overall way the body is held; alignment is the specific positioning of body parts in relation to each other for efficient movement.

questions.question: Q: Why is spatial awareness important in group dance?
questions.correctAnswer: Spatial awareness allows dancers to maintain correct formations, avoid collisions, use the performance space effectively and ensure the audience can see the choreography.

questions.question: Q: How does control affect the quality of a slow, sustained movement?
questions.correctAnswer: Control enables the dancer to move with even speed and steady dynamics, creating a smooth, continuous line without wobbling or losing balance.

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on Technical Dance Skills

questions.question: Q: Explain how poor alignment can lead to injury.
questions.correctAnswer: Poor alignment places stress on joints and muscles incorrectly, for example landing a jump with misaligned knees can strain ligaments and cause long-term damage.

questions.question: Q: Why are technical skills necessary for expressive performance?
questions.correctAnswer: Without technical accuracy, the dancer cannot communicate the intended mood or meaning clearly — for example, poor control undermines the quality of a soft, lyrical phrase.
